finding: EP012 CycleGAN (kermany->neh) did not reduce cohort separability; translation moved Kermany away from NEH in ConvNeXt feature space

cohort_probe.note: identical manifest, splits, 128px resize and frozen ConvNeXt-Tiny; only difference is passage through the generator

limitation: Kermany and NEH differ simultaneously in device, export resolution, file format, site, population and labelling practice; this supports a claim about cohort information, not scanner bias specifically
